gumtree_entries.description: ADDED i2: getSpecifier for a RunCodec whose A and B codecs are both the same non-default canonical codec encodes the run length (1825) plus both codecs.
ADDED i3: getSpecifier for a RunCodec whose A codec is a PopulationCodec and whose B codec equals the default-for-band; the matching default is omitted from the output.
ADDED i4: getSpecifier for a RunCodec with the maximum possible run length exercises the largest "kx" branch of the run-length encoding.
ADDED i5: getSpecifier for a RunCodec built from canonical codec #13, with that same codec passed as default-for-band.
ADDED i6: getCodec with value 116 reads two header bytes from the stream to build a BHSDCodec; getSpecifier then round-trips that codec back to a specifier.
ADDED i7: value 116 consumes 2 of the 9 available bytes.
ADDED i8: getCodec for a population-codec value (166) consumes header bytes from a buffered stream; the BufferedInputStream drains the underlying stream fully.
ADDED i9: getSpecifierForDefaultCodec returns the single canonical specifier index of a canonical codec (CHAR3 maps to 116... here its canonical index).
ADDED i10: getCodec with a value (142) that requires reading from the stream throws a NullPointerException when the stream is null.
ADDED i13: getCodec with a value (179) that requires reading from the stream throws a NullPointerException when the stream is null.
ADDED i16: getCodec for a run-codec value (141) over a fully-zero buffered stream decodes successfully and drains the underlying stream.
ADDED i17: getCodec rejects an out-of-range codec encoding byte (2756) with an IOException reporting the invalid byte.
ADDED i19: getCodec with value 2 returns the corresponding canonical BHSDCodec; verify the default codec and the returned codec retain their expected ranges.
ADDED i20: getCodec on a run-codec value (137) whose header read comes from an unconnected pipe surfaces the pipe's "Pipe not connected" IOException.
ADDED i22: Two successive getCodec calls (population value 188, then 117) sharing one buffered stream both decode and leave the underlying stream drained.
ADDED i23: getCodec on a run-codec value (130) whose header read comes from an unconnected pipe surfaces the pipe's "Pipe not connected" IOException.
ADDED i25: getCodec for a run-codec value (128) decodes a RunCodec from a single byte; getSpecifier then encodes it back with UNSIGNED5 as the default-for-band.
ADDED i26: getCodec with value 116 needs two header bytes; a single-byte stream runs out mid-decode and an EOFException is thrown.
ADDED i28: After a buffered read for value 166 has consumed the underlying bytes, a subsequent value-116 decode on the now-empty stream throws EOFException.
ADDED i29: The buffered read drains the underlying stream.
ADDED i31: getCodec rejects a negative encoding value with an IllegalArgumentException.
ADDED i34: The deprecated no-arg constructor can still be instantiated.
